name: Stock Price Prediction (AI4ALL)
description: A financial NLP pipeline predicting next-day stock price direction from headlines and market data.
longDescription: Built an end-to-end financial NLP pipeline over 322K headlines and 20M stock records using FinBERT sentiment analysis. Designed a novel Competitive Pressure Index capturing negative news surge relative to each stock's baseline coverage, then trained a Random Forest classifier achieving 54% 5-fold cross-validated accuracy alongside a Logistic Regression baseline with full confusion matrix evaluation.

name: BuukEasy
description: A booking platform with a mobile-first UI for solo beauty and wellness professionals.
longDescription: Built a booking platform with a mobile-first UI and scheduling workflows for solo beauty and wellness professionals. Launched an MVP for client booking and scheduling, serving 5 clients and iterating on features based on user feedback.

name: CITIES Dashboard
description: An interactive air quality dashboard for schools across Accra.
longDescription: Co-developed an interactive dashboard providing 20K+ students across Accra schools with air quality insights, and automated deployment workflows using GitHub Actions to streamline CI/CD and reduce manual deployment effort.
